name: Incendiary Ammo
description: A special deployment item that modifies a primary weapon's magazine to ignite infected upon contact. These rounds guarantee a one-hit kill against Common and Uncommon Infected across all difficulties. Special Infected stay ignited for 5 seconds when hit, while a Witch takes 15 seconds to burn completely. CEDA agents and Jimmy Gibbs Jr. are immune to the fire effect. When deployed with a Grenade Launcher, it creates a massive, Molotov-like explosion that sets targets ablaze instead of staggering them
